panels.title: Active Drivers
panels.description: Drivers with a session in the last 30 days

panels.title: Total Revenue
panels.description: Completed-session revenue in the company currency.

panels.title: Avg Session kWh
panels.description: Rolling average kWh per completed session (last 30 days)

panels.title: Average Sessions by Hour of Day
panels.description: Average number of active sessions by hour (last 30 days)

panels.title: Connected Depot Systems
panels.description: WebSocket connections over every API process. Fewer than the systems turned on, while the interface is on, means a depot system is offline.

panels.title: Refused Charging Requests
panels.description: Requests of the last lists of the depot systems that were not applied. The depot system page lists each one.

panels.title: Depot Sign-Ins per Minute by Result
panels.description: Results: ok, wrong_password, unknown_system, waiting (the address waits after failures), disabled, no_credentials, plain_http, rate_limited, busy, interface_off. Locks: address (10 failures) or system (the ceiling).

panels.title: Charging Request Lists (15 min) by Result
panels.description: applied: the list reached the departures. failed or recheck_failed: the next list applies it.

panels.title: Sites Over Capacity
panels.description: Sites whose last allocation measured a draw above the site capacity.

panels.title: Sites With a Failed Limit Send

targets.legendFormat: Sites With a Failed Limit Send

panels.description: The next cycle sends the limits again.

panels.title: Battery and Solar Credit
panels.description: Supply credited in the last allocation of every site. A credit limit goes to the stations as a credit profile that ends with its reading.

panels.title: Oldest Limit Send
panels.description: A cycle sends every site's limits at least every 5 minutes. Above 15 minutes the cycle is not running.

panels.title: Load Management Cycles (last hour) by Status
Stale Charging Plans
panels.description: Depot plans marked stale more than a minute ago and not planned again.

panels.title: Plan Staleness and At Risk Notices
Stale Readings
panels.description: Connected assets with telemetry whose reading is missing or past its lifetime: they give no supply credit.

panels.title: Readings Refused per Minute by Status
panels.description: 409: older than the stored reading. 400: the asset takes no readings from the API or the value is out of range. 403: the key lacks loadManagement:write.
